{{Quote|But during your time away, you must not forget what Dathomir has given to you. Although space is cold and empty, Dathomir's wilderness is lush and rich. It may be years before you return, so never forget the place that birthed and nurtured you – you will always be a Nightsister.|Mother Talzin|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''''Wild Power''''' was [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin's]] manifesto written to explain the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], their [[Dathomir Magic|powers]], their [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|beliefs]] and their role in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
This manual was written during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Talzin was [[Mother (title)/Legends|mother]] and [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|shaman]] of all [[Witch/Legends|witches]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. At some point, the manual fell into the hands of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. The latter included many handwritten comments throughout the pages, comparing Talzin's teachings with those of her new master, [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].<ref name="BOS" />

[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] somehow recovered this text and included it in his ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a collection of writings dealing with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], which was published after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] (circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19]]&ndash;[[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]).<ref name="BOS" />
